pre_correction_observation.json_observed: Japanese and lowercase English positive cases passed their assertions; mixed-case English returned SUSPEND/CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE before the complete parser. The separate duplicate-key test passed all four format/side cases.
pre_correction_observation.csv_case_evidence: The CSV admission/full-header case-rule mismatch was found statically. Its cased-English pre-fix variant was not reached because the Japanese case first failed JSON parsing.
causes: The right-side CSV serialization loop emitted no comma before its first cell, joining two JSON string tokens without a separator. The generic DocumentResult validator checked spans and byte budgets, not JSON syntax, so the invalid table was committed.
CSV and JSON join coarse admission guards were case-sensitive while their existing complete header parsers used (?i).

corrections: Emit a comma before each right-side CSV cell, since a validated named left-key column guarantees an already emitted nonempty left side. This preserves every right-side output span at its actual newly emitted token.
Use (?i) join prefix admission matching the existing complete header regexes, retaining exact bodies and column/key values; advance the parser revision.

tests_and_route.route_method: Tests launch minidora-rust with --json and real fresh stores; fresh inspect processes verify persisted results. CSV source/output spans are read from the actual dependency returned by CLI via actor/case-checked Store::get_bytes; no action or result is synthesized.
tests_and_route.post_review_verification: The CSV oracle gained exact span tuple coverage/uniqueness and row/column output offsets; the CLI suite plus workspace format/check/lint were rerun. Product source was unchanged from the successful input/document unit tests and build.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; scoped joined-table normal routes and affected input/document components were exercised with workspace all-target compile/lint. Prior full-workspace records belong to their own snapshots.

route_observations.span_evidence: The actual persisted DocumentResult dependency has the exact expected 14 unique header/cell/unmatched-key span tuples. Every source start/end is checked against the known row/cell in the correct side; output offsets are checked against the expected output array/object row and column, including equal left/right key values. Quoted UTF-8 cells and namespace header tokens are checked.

route_observations.span_evidence: Exact full-wrapper and per-side hashes, all selected/header cell ranges, both sides of every emitted row and unmatched-key ranges are checked against unique raw lexemes within the expected side. Raw north and escaped north join by decoded equality while retaining different original byte ranges.

render_and_persistence_evidence: All positive cases check RENDERED, render SHA-256 equal to actual text bytes, content-plan text equality, one result dependency and original request/document plus complete result in a separate inspect process.

versioned_recomputation_probe.method: Copy the closed actual pre-correction CSV CLI store byte-for-byte into a separate recovery store; use the same actor/case/input. This restores real prior state, without synthesizing an earlier action or result.
versioned_recomputation_probe.exact_version_1_retry: Returns the original invalid committed result unchanged.
versioned_recomputation_probe.explicit_version_2: COMMIT with schema-valid corrected joined rows; the previous invalid result remains in prior_results.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local diagnostic state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: Scoped authored cases do not establish an independent held-out population or complete B04 acceptance.

Previously persisted invalid CSV COMMIT results are not silently rewritten; exact retries preserve their historical bytes. Explicit versioned recomputation was observed, not automatic store migration.
Only exact unique-key inner joins are covered; outer joins, duplicate-key expansion, inferred schemas, other structured routes and wider transformations remain outside this follow-up.
Full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected normal CSV/JSON join routes and typed duplicate stops observed, not the complete B04 contract
